inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL date recipe computes the last day of a month by advancing the first day of the current month and subtracting one day, then extracts its day number with DAYOFMONTH.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored billing-calendar audit. Fixed anchor dates cover leap-February, a thirty-day month, and SQL NULL; YEAR, MONTH, DATE_ADD, DATE_SUB, and DAYOFMONTH derive and expose each month end without copying the source variables or literals.

fixture_notes: Anchor 701 exercises leap-year February, anchor 702 exercises April month-end, and anchor 703 preserves NULL through the derived month-end and day-number expressions.
determinism_notes: Anchor dates, labels, arithmetic intervals, and ordering are fixed with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE billing_anchors (anchor_id INT PRIMARY KEY, anchor_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, anchor_date DATE NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT anchor_id, anchor_label, anchor_date, DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(anchor_date), '-', MONTH(anchor_date), '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS month_end, DAYOFMONTH(DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(anchor_date), '-', MONTH(anchor_date), '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS month_end_day FROM billing_anchors ORDER BY anchor_id
